judgment.rationale: The merged Scoop change covers the original packaging path, not all later official-installer reports. A version and install path are needed before attributing the remaining case.
evidence: The original reporter used Scoop 0.100 and said the official installer resolved that instance.
Scoop's package fix was merged; later reports include official installations and a 0.102 administrative MSI extraction missing files under WinUI3Apps.
Read the full issue discussion and https://github.com/ScoopInstaller/Extras/pull/18020.

The pinned MSI custom action copies files from the manifest during installation; an administrative extraction is not evidence that action ran: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c/installer/PowerToysSetupCustomActionsVNext/CustomAction.cpp.
